The success toast for renaming a team now comes from the `useUpdateTeam` hook instead of the component. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

Changes, all in `apps/react-vite/src/features/teams/`:

- **`api/update-team.ts`**: `useUpdateTeam` now calls `useNotifications()` and shows the `Team Renamed` success notification in `onSuccess`, after the teams query is invalidated. The `mutationConfig.onSuccess` callback still runs after that, so callers can add their own behaviour.
- **`components/update-team.tsx`**: removed the `useNotifications` import and the `addNotification` call. The component now calls `useUpdateTeam()` with no config.

One thing I did not change: the other feature components (`create-comment.tsx`, `delete-user.tsx`, `update-discussion.tsx` and others) also call `useNotifications` directly. They predate this change, so I left them alone. Moving them to the hooks would be a separate refactor, in its own pull request, as the project's conventions ask.

I also didn't commit anything.
